controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-12T20:06:42.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:06:42.000Z"
        AND source.ip IN ("172.18.0.12", "172.18.0.16", "172.18.0.19", "172.18.0.13", "172.18.0.5")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS count = COUNT(*)
        BY source.ip, host.name
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
